Before the next topic, a short check on how routers forward.

```quiz
{"mode":"practice","title":"Forwarding","questions":[{"question":"Which OSI layer makes forwarding decisions based on IP addresses?","options":["Data link","Network","Transport","Session"],"answer":"B","explanation":"Routers forward packets at the network layer, using the destination IP address."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."}]}
```
